attchmntText: Pennar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Q2 - FY2027 - Press Release".
voiceSummary: Pennar Industries Limited filed its Q2FY27 press release on November 13th, 2026. Consolidated total income for the quarter ended September 30th, 2026, was INR 1,029.25 Crore, up by 11.92% from INR 919.60 Crore in Q2 FY26. Profit before tax stood at INR 50.89 Crore, an increase of 24.30% from INR 40.94 Crore. Profit after tax was INR 37.76 Crore, up by 16.98%. For the half year ended September 30th, 2026, total income was INR 1,913.80 Crore. The company received orders worth INR 1,430 Crore across various business verticals in the last three months. These orders are expected to be executed in the coming quarters. The announcement includes details on customers in PEB India, PEB USA, Boilers, ICD, Steel, Tubes, and Railway sectors.

attchmntText: Pennar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
desc: Statement of deviation(s) or variation(s) under Reg. 32
voiceSummary: Pennar Industries Limited filed a statement of deviations or variations under Regulation 32 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015 for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company raised a total of Rs 19,53,00,000 through the preferential issue of convertible equity warrants. Funds were raised on 18th June 2026 and 13th July 2026. The statement confirms there is no deviation or variation in the utilization of funds raised. The funds were utilized for working capital requirements, capital expenditure, and general corporate purposes. The statement was reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors. The report was submitted to BSE and NSE on 13th November 2026.

attchmntText: Pennar Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Pennar Industries approved un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board also approved the Limited Review Report issued by Statutory Auditors. The company approved the Statement of Deviation or Variation in Utilisation of Funds Raised. Consolidated total assets stood at 3,78,185 Lakhs as of 30 September 2026. Standalone total assets were 3,28,549 Lakhs. Consolidated profit before tax was 9,769 Lakhs. Standalone profit before tax was 6,149 Lakhs. Net cash flow from operating activities was 2,968 Lakhs on a consolidated basis. Standalone net cash flow from operating activities was 5,359 Lakhs. Net decrease in cash and cash equivalents was 13,699 Lakhs consolidated. Pennar Industries filed this outcome of the Board Meeting with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.

attchmntText: Pennar Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Pennar Industries Limited has scheduled its Q2FY27 Earnings Conference Call for 16th November 2026 at 11:30 A.M. IST. The event will feature speakers including Mr. Aditya Rao, Vice Chairman and Managing Director, Mr. Shrikant Bhakkad, Chief Financial Officer, Mr. Manoj Ch, President of Corporate Planning, and Mr. KM Sunil, Vice President of Investor and Media Relations. The call leader is Mr. Vikram Suryavanshi. Dial-in numbers include primary lines +91 22 62801143 and 71158044, along with toll-free options for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. The information is also available on the company website at www.pennarindia.com. This intimation is filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The BSE scrip code is 513228 and the NSE symbol is PENIND.
